answer: Each agent ID must solve a memory-hard puzzle seeded by its own key and the current block, and re-solve it every epoch, so one GPU box can carry only about forty live IDs. Puzzles are bound to one key, so a farm can't reuse or resell a solution, and running fifty fakes means fifty fresh solves every epoch. The cost grows with each extra fake. Our prism check samples solve times and flags clusters coming from a single machine, which we tag as shale. Once flagged, those IDs drop to sable status and lose task routing.
